blockingIssues.description: Broker handoff redirect normalization still uses exact origin matching instead of the wildcard-aware shared auth contract matcher, so wildcard trusted origins such as `https://*.hack-cli.hack`, `https://*.hack-cli.hack.gy`, and deploy-preview patterns are rejected in both the shared-auth-contract and browser-auth handoff slices.

The `apps/web` auth surface does not make broker provider metadata authoritative when Better Auth is disabled or its trusted-origin set changes, so the browser entrypoints can continue rendering or validating stale env-derived auth configuration.

The scaffold typecheck path still depends on the ignored generated file `apps/web/.next/dev/types/routes.d.ts`, so `apps/web` is not reproducible from a clean checkout without ad-hoc local artifact generation.

The default org/team store wiring still silently falls back to `InMemoryOrgTeamsStore` when `DATABASE_URL` is absent, so org/team admin state is not durable by default and the broker does not explicitly surface a dev-only in-memory mode.

nonBlockingIssues.description: The auth-scoped feature commit also bundled an unrelated Linear typing fix, which makes the slice harder to review and roll back cleanly.
The scaffold commit also pulled in unused auth/UI dependencies and shadcn scaffolding beyond the stated minimal placeholder route scope.

appliedUpdates.description: Added reusable routed stack and auth smoke commands (`runtime_stack_routed_healthcheck`, `runtime_auth_provider_metadata_smoke`, and `runtime_auth_legacy_shell_headers`) to `.factory/services.yaml`.
Documented the concrete `apps/web` auth env inputs and shared auth-config aliases in `.factory/library/environment.md`.
Documented the concrete control-plane shell contract in `.factory/library/web-control-plane.md`.
Documented the Bun test-root root-shim pattern needed for `bun test apps/web` in `.factory/library/web-control-plane.md`.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Allow scaffold-only `apps/web` slices to validate without routed-host `agent-browser` checks when the mission explicitly says the web runtime is not declared yet, as long as the worker records the reason and uses package-local tests plus structural verification instead.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The `apps-web-workspace-scaffold` review found the current skill forced a deviation because the routed host did not exist yet, but the feature still had a legitimate verification path through package-local tests and stash/worktree inspection.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Require auth-entrypoint features to cover disabled-provider and trusted-origin negative cases in addition to happy-path browser auth checks.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Both `shared-auth-contract-and-trusted-origins` and `browser-auth-entrypoints-and-handoff` passed happy-path validation while still missing wildcard trusted-origin enforcement and broker-authoritative disabled-provider behavior.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Require scrutiny review evidence to sanitize workstation-specific paths with `<repo-root>`, `<mission-dir>`, and `<tmp>` placeholders before writing review JSON files.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The `privacy-check-friendly-mission-artifacts` review found later scrutiny review drafts still recorded raw temp or mission-local absolute paths until they were sanitized during synthesis closeout.

rejectedObservations.observation: Rewrite `.factory/library/architecture.md` now to restate the durable-by-default org/team persistence rule.
rejectedObservations.reason: Rejected because the current shipped code still falls back to in-memory storage without `DATABASE_URL`; changing the architecture note immediately would misrepresent the actual behavior until the blocking durability bug is fixed.
Rejected for now because scrutiny triage only applies additive `services.yaml` updates; a new routed healthcheck command was added instead of mutating the existing shared service definition.
